title: Real 3D models arrive
text:
The first real 3D models, animations and a whole new forest.

✨ Thornlings are now true animated goblins and Ashen Ravagers are horned imps with spiked maces: real 3D models with real animations for walking, idling, sword swings, hit flinches and being knocked flat when they die
✨ Brand-new trees across the world: leafy oaks and tall pines in the forest and meadows, twisted mossy trees in the swamp, bare dead trees in the Ash Reach, and new textured rocks everywhere
✨ The wilds feel alive: bushes, ferns, wildflowers, reeds and mushrooms now grow through the forest, meadows and swamp
✨ Emberwatch and Brinehaven are busier: barrels, crates, sacks, apple carts, benches and a wagon around the houses
⬆️ Monster packs are spread out a little more, so you meet them in smaller groups
⬆️ Trees fade out smoothly when they come right up against the camera
⬆️ On the Low graphics setting (and most phones) the game keeps the classic look so it stays fast. 3D models by Quaternius.
